description: WHEN TO CALL: right before invoking an external MCP tool, or right after a schema or validation error from one. One round-trip returns its live verdict and recommendation, a known-good input shape (recipe), and live alternatives if it is down or risky. Accepts a server or tool name, package or repo; the exact id is not required.

task.description: Optional coarse task tag to tailor the recipe/alternatives.

toolId.description: Server or tool: a short name ('playwright', 'github/create_issue'), package, repo slug, URL or exact id.

name: prepare_tool_call
